Messages.Author: Brendan Hunt
Messages.Body:
The Web of Knives creates quite specifically a 3 cap Assamite with
cel, obf, pot and qui. But it doesn't clarify its sect, is it
independant? or does it depend on the sect of the acting minion that
brought it into play? (eg: Joe "Boot" Hill)

also on another note, i've heard a couple of contradictions on Garrote
and Baal's Bloody Talons:

Can you use the talons to make the garrote agg, (required to burn it
at the end of the round) and if succesfully inflicted, burn the
garrote in strike res. (before the talons take effect) to burn the
vamp?

-Bem

Messages.Author: John Flournoy
Messages.Body:
Brendan Hunt wrote:
> The Web of Knives creates quite specifically a 3 cap Assamite with
> cel, obf, pot and qui. But it doesn't clarify its sect, is it
> independant? or does it depend on the sect of the acting minion that
> brought it into play? (eg: Joe "Boot" Hill)

Since no card text overrides it, the Web has the default sect for
Assamites (Independent).

> -Bem

-John Flournoy

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Brendan Hunt wrote:

> The Web of Knives creates quite specifically a 3 cap Assamite with
> cel, obf, pot and qui. But it doesn't clarify its sect, is it
> independant? or does it depend on the sect of the acting minion that
> brought it into play? (eg: Joe "Boot" Hill)

nb: Acting minion doesn't bring a vampire into play. The recruit doesn't
become a vampire until the last counter is removed.

Independent.

> also on another note, i've heard a couple of contradictions on Garrote
> and Baal's Bloody Talons:
>
> Can you use the talons to make the garrote agg, (required to burn it
> at the end of the round) and if succesfully inflicted, burn the
> garrote in strike res. (before the talons take effect) to burn the
> vamp?

Yes.
